svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 160 x 430 x 3 mm; corners rounded.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 9 mm holes 90 from its west edge, 30 from the top and bottom,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the M8 bolts into the north-west leg's outward leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark and drill the electronics box's four fixing holes through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: box itself (box centred 20 west of the bolts, 60 above the bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the plate); M5 screws and nyloc nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sensor shield arm: 20 x 3 aluminium strip bent to a Z, riveted to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the plate's top corner; the bought shield screws to its top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the north face of the leg, so the box faces north, shaded by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the collector, its lid away from the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the box lid opens fully.
